questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Hurry up, (   ) you'll miss the bus.
questions.explanation: 命令文, or 〜 で「…しなさい、さもないと〜」。and だと「そうすれば」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I stayed home (   ) I had a cold.
questions.explanation: 理由を表す接続詞 because。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: It was raining, (   ) we didn't go out.
questions.explanation: 結果を表す so（だから）。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) he is rich, he isn't happy.
questions.explanation: although は「〜だけれども」（譲歩）。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Please turn off the lights (   ) you leave the room.
questions.explanation: 「部屋を出るときに」。when は時を表す接続詞。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: My mother called me (   ) I was taking a bath.
questions.explanation: while + 主語 + 動詞 で「〜している間に」。during は前置詞で後ろに名詞をとる。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I think (   ) she is right.
questions.explanation: think の目的語になる that 節（「〜ということ」）。この that は省略されることも多い。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I don't know (   ) she will come.
questions.explanation: 「〜かどうか」を表す if（= whether）。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Study hard, (   ) you will pass.
questions.explanation: 命令文 ＋ and「〜しなさい、そうすれば」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Both Tom (   ) Ken are my friends.
questions.explanation: both A and B「A も B も」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Either you (   ) I must go.
questions.explanation: either A or B「A か B のどちらか」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Not only he (   ) his wife likes jazz.
questions.explanation: not only A but (also) B「A だけでなく B も」。動詞は B に合わせる。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I will wait here (   ) you come back.
questions.explanation: until「〜するまで（ずっと）」。by は前置詞。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) I got home, it was dark.
questions.explanation: when「〜したとき」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Wash your hands (   ) you eat.
questions.explanation: before「〜する前に」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: He was so tired (   ) he fell asleep.
questions.explanation: so 〜 that …「とても〜なので…」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) you hurry, you'll be late.
questions.explanation: unless「〜しない限り」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Neither he (   ) I was there.
questions.explanation: neither A nor B「A も B も〜ない」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I'll call you as soon as I (   ) there.
questions.explanation: 時を表す節の中では、未来のことも現在形。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) it was cold, we went swimming.
questions.explanation: though「〜だけれども」。
